side_guide_screen.limit: Bounding corners; no elastic deflection, friction, tolerance or fault state credit

DT3_extended_shaft_screen.basis: Reuse DT3 parallel-axis geometry:375 flange length,70 offset each end; actual shaft universal joints and supports not changed. OEM angle/speed/life and full swept-solid acceptance pending.
DT3_extended_shaft_screen.status: ARCHIVED DT3 PARALLEL-AXIS COMPARISON ONLY; DT3 audit found unequal joint angles. DT4 removes these shafts.

height.status: Retained development height. NOT a production freeze.
blocked_by: DT4 direct-motor carrier/torque restraint and new truck/unsprung masses
Complete weighed mass/CG and body reaction solution
Selected springs/dampers with actual installed lengths and rates
Lead/trailing carrier and tender support designs
Local joint, fatigue and stability review

mass.limit: Keeps old body reactions for sensitivity only. New cab/shell and body attachment masses require full reaction solve; axle-mounted housings/gears still need split.
mass.status: DT3 MASS SENSITIVITY ONLY; do not transfer combined mass or spring/damper rates into DT4.

load_screens.yaw_root_formula: Tmax=U/4 + (H*145)/(2*95). Rigid four-bolt group; no prying/contact/preload redistribution.
load_screens.limit: Nominal elastic demand ONLY. No material allowable, safety factor, fatigue life, weld capacity, thread stripping or countersunk-head capacity conclusion.
load_screens.catch_mass_basis: Archived DT3 lower-mass proxy only; recalculate one-catch loads for complete DT4 mass. No strength release.

limits: Reported gap is a conservative axis-aligned bounding-box gap, not exact surface separation; exact positive-volume intersections checked only for overlapping boxes
Targeted checks do not cover every solid pair over full travel
Threads, locking washer cams, seals and cotter forming are boundaries
Bearing fit and end-stack tolerances remain supplier/machining release holds
Bolster and DT hole patterns are proposals, not approvals from the separate drivetrain chat

current_drivetrain.architecture: Four 376 cc hydraulic shaft motors, one per solid axle, 1:1 coupling
current_drivetrain.status: DT3-derived shaft and suspension results below are archived sensitivities, NOT applicable selections for DT4.

DT4_motor_envelope_screen.limit: Nominal envelope only. No motor carriers, torque restraints, flex services or combined movement accepted.
